tactics:
induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      simp only [List.findIdx_cons] at h
      cases hx : p x <;> simp_all
    | succ j =>
      simp only [List.findIdx_cons] at h
      cases hx : p x <;> simp_all <;> exact ih (by omega)
induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.findIdx_cons] <;> cases hx : p _ <;> simp_all
